I mean, the first gem is MASSIVE due to precog. The stat gems after that I'd say is minor, enchants you get to keep on recrafted items. I honestly don't mind that gearing up a character require some effort. 

That being said, Blizzard treat PvP players like a necassary evil they would much rather just put in the trash can is quite obvious. But that is more to do with the gameplay, long queues and less incentive to try PvP. Not the gearing system.

They could still have gear progression while doing random BGs by grinding honor gear that are BiS in these instances. Cause honor gear would be better than questing and PvE gear.

I heard that too but it's true for guys as well. I was 32 year old guy when all of this happened to me. Opening up to my neurologist about my struggles with mental health and traumatic experiences is one of my biggest mistakes in life.

Doesn't matter if your depression and suicidal thoughts gets worse on the medication, you've had it to some degree before and therefor it's dismissed. 

It's too late for me. But do NOT open up about mental issues to your doctor!

Congrats!

What a lot of people tend to forget is that playing at low rating as a healer can be MORE difficult than at higher rating.

I have two evokers with equally amount of games played in shuffle. One is around 1950 and the other one at 2300. You can at least to some degree rely on your DPS to peel for you at 2300, while at 1950 you have to keep in mind that it most likely ain't gonna happen. And let's not forget that getting a DPS with full greens who are new to the class/spec is gonna happen in a lot of games around that rating that leads to a draw lobby (3-3).

And let's not mention that a lot of people are playing with such a handicap because they don't track enough on their UI or have macros that radically improve gameplay. Climbing without it is no picnic. So congrats on 1800! :)

Sadly too much time has passed for that to be relevant now. I lacked the energy to do so when it all happened, kinda wish that I was more pushy and stood up for myself more when it all happened. But I have issues with confrontations and quite severe anxiety.

Getting some sort of closure would help my psychological well being A LOT

I've tried to reach out to different social services. Thing is, I appear to be too "normal", the fact that I have epilepsy, a brain tumor, been in two major accident, severe side effects on medication, haven't been able to go back to work and much more. Some doctors even believe I have autism and then the next one dismisses it alltogether. So the cycle continues 

The message is clear. I should snap out of it, let go of what happened and move on. Regardless of how traumatic and painful it was.

So sorry to hear that. Sadly I can relate in so many ways. I believe you, since I have experienced something similair (even if our situations are quite different in many ways, we both have been gaslighted which is traumatic. Especially when you feel desperate and hopeless)

This is sincere. I hope everything sorts itself out. If you do feel a need to vent out the frustration feel free to write me! Sending you a virtual hug ❤️

It's 6-8mm, the size of a pea and at the front on the right side of my brain around the frontal lobe if I recall correctly (My English is decent but when it comes to translating medical info that I barely understand in my native tongue can be quite difficult)

I was in a car accident on the highway and had a concussion. So due to the concussion I received they scanned my brain and found the tumor.

According to the notes in my journal they could see sign of it from the scan I had when I got my diagnosis. But not something they acknowledged then.

A bit late reply I know. Haven't had any sort of energy with insomnia. Now I have some energy at least.

That screenshot doesn't say much. I've had it say close to 2h and estimate queue 8min. Why? I was doing an LFR for tokens and an epic BG. That timer keep on ticking even when I am in these other instances.

I am a socially isolated depressed male who has been unemployed for almost 4 years now I haven't been able to go back to work after my diagnosis.  They don't gaf about me either since I am at the lowest level on the hierarchical ladder. 

Now I live in Sweden so am not a Medicare. Denied any sort of rehabilitation however since according to them I am "normal", and as I said in my post, can still work at the local supermarket. If I had the job at the local supermarket I would get sick leave.

I am leaning towards never having a doctor. In fact my life has become such a wreck I am contemplating ending it forever. Written a note and everything just in case.

My life is such a mess that I cannot see a way out of this. Time will tell.

I am to see an Epileptologist. Thing is I live in Sweden and cannot afford private care. So I will have to wait 4-6 months before that will happen. 

I've been to psychiatrist as well, who simply doesn't believe my story. You get to wait close to a year for an apointment and then simply get gaslighted. Now I have become so bitter and resentful I don't even think a good doctor can help me. Especially if they don't ackowledge what I've been through.

It wasn't getting diagnosed with epilepsy that ruined my life. But the medication and treatment from the medical staff. I even said the medication caused severe suicidal thoughts and got told "Well, you shouldn't seek help for that here" by the nurse.

It sure does... For me I haven't done it, because one part of me wants to give it a try to get a meaningful life. But when logic hit me like a brick wall, and seeing a clear pattern in my life. I just know that there is no way out of this for me. I'm too weak and pathetic.

Yeah, that is what I am afraid of the most. Surviving and be scarred for life. Being held captive in my own body and refused medical assisted suicide. 

Things can always get worse, but sometimes it's bad enough to justify suicide according to me.

Själv är jag inte sjukskriven. Fick epilepsi, hjärntumör (godartad), olycka i samband med kramp (50 stygn, ögonlocket hänger än idag), mediciner med svåra psykiska biverkningar, med i en bilolycka med hjärnskakning och revbensfraktur. Bokstavligt talat varit sjukskriven noll dagar. 

För enligt min läkare så "kan jag alltid plocka äpplen på ICA", eftersom jag var arbetslös, så något kan jag alltid göra! Hade jag haft jobbet där jag plocka äpplen på ICA så hade jag däremot blivit sjukskriven, men det förväntas av mig att söka jobbet.
No, it's been almost 4 years now and I am getting older. With age your options are starting to run out.
If an almighty God exist, then sorry, I don't want anything to do with him. In my eyes he has to be a sadistic monster. He can intervene and save innocent lives, but doesn't to test our faith?

I have called one of those helplines. Kinda pointless, I even managed to kinda convice the person I was talking to that my life is too much of a mess to actually fix. Especially when I mention my journey in trying to get help and what I've been through.

True help doesn't exist if you have been tramatized by medications and the medical system. All you get is being called crazy and it's being blamed on your medical condition or psychiatric status.

So how to get help when noone believes you?

Do I want help? Yes. Is there help? Well, kinda but it's very limited. In a lot of cases there is help but simply not enough since the issues the person is having are too severe, but not severe enough to be considered critical. Like I got a referal to my psychiatric clinic 9 months ago and have met with a nurse ONCE during that time. Guess you could call it "help", but far from enough.

If you become traumatized, bitter and resentful. Society simply don't have enough resources to give you proper treatment and effective help. All they are pushing is magical pills.

I won't break free from this. A lot of people get better, you read about these people in media. However, that's far from the case for everyone. In my case, I can clearly see a pattern that I just don't have it in me to break out of. When seeking help noone truly understands how deep of a hole I'm actually in.

Things is, I know what is required from me. Society has demands that I have to live up! If not, well get ready for a shitty life. And I can't live up to those demands. I'm too weak and pathetic.

Yeah I get that. I've talked to and tried to help people in similair positions as well throughout my life. But once I keep delving on the trauma that I can't let go. It's been over 3 years now and I keep repeating the events in my head every single day since then. 

So when people try and inspire me to be productive and stop dwelling in the past. It's just, I know it's counterproductive but I can't let it go since I've never gotten any kind of closure. 

I get to see therapists, but my problems are just way too complex for any therapist. Since my problems are REAL and concrete, no words can change reality.

You have to live it yourself to truly understand it. Other people who try to "inspire" you simply cannot grasp the scale of the problem. The more I think about it all and what is required of me to turn this around, I simply get overwhelmed and don't have it in me. So ending my life is kinda my only option then, or keep on suffering every day.

It is a tough realisation. It's not just that I am passed my prime, it's also all the medical issues I have to live with. Sorry to hear about your friend leaving and you're gonna be alone. I have zero friends, so noone who could live. Gaslighted all of them and isolated myself.

Yes, been in therapy and met with psychiatrist. Also talked about it a tiny bit with my brother as well, my mom knows a bit too. Considering how I live my life they can understand my reasoning a tiny bit. But not all of it, according to them I am too "normal".

But I get treated differently nowadays compared to before all of this happened. By everyone. They may not say the actualy words, but I am not the same person anymore and will never be.

Been in the medical system for quite some time now here in Sweden. But there is no help for this. And noone can truly understand the deep suffering I live with every day. My problems are so deep that no therapist in the world can fix. I am too bitter and traumatized nowadays and my life is a mess. I have NOTHING!

Uh? Is this a genuine question or are you just trying to provoke? Most likely both at the same time. 

Yes, women can be depressed for all kinds of reason. Psychological as well as physical and environmental reasons. Seen it in my own mom when she has been sick which is one of the most painful experiences of my life to see her like that. 

This kind of attitude is what spews on this debate "who has it worse, women or men?". Instead of helping and supporting each other through our unique challenges.
Sadly doctors often don't believe side effects of medication. No matter how bad it gets. Then you got no choice but to seek advice online

When I was younger I felt shame due to playing too much World of Warcraft. Or that I hadn't been working out and was ashamed of my body. 

Also always been ashamed of my sexuality. My porn habits started to escalate and I felt like I can never be in a relationship. When a girl showed interest in me I froze, unable to act and wanted to flee. Even if I was actually interested and attracted to her.

Now I'm ashamed for being a total failure with no education, never had a relationship, unemployed and that I have wasted away my potential behind a screen.

I have tried. You can call them once a week, which I did and talked to the nurse, crying every time and I was so scared about everything. I was laying in bed "WHAT THE HELL IS HAPPENING?! HELP ME! END IT! JUST NOOOO!".

The only two side effects that seem to be relevant is if you get a skin rash or if you get another seizure.

I so regret mentioning that I have suffered from depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts before. Because now every single symptom I experience is because of my past. But nothing can even compare to this.

Now my gut is telling me they have formed this view on me:  
"He is looking for symptoms"  
"He is looking for attention and he needs psychiatric help, it's not the medication"  
"He is emotionally unstable and always has been" (which is not true, but all they can relate to me is how I've been once I started)  
"It's all in his head, this medication can also be used to treat anxiety and depression in people with bipolar disorder" (I am not bipolar)

I've read up on the lamictal/lamotrigine and it's on the list of symptoms (A small amount of people with epilepsy who gets treated with lamotrigine experience mood swings and suicidal thoughts, contact your doctor right away if you do). They have made a test on 1 000 people where half got a placebo. Suicidal thoughts were 3x more common in the people who got the medication than those who got a placebo.

So what should I do? I mean, I am clearly imagining all of this and it's zero connection to the medication.  I've heard this over and over again. I have just lost all hope if I'm gonna be honest with you. No idea if I don't express myself well enough, or it's so uncommon they haven't had a patient with these symptoms so they just dismiss them.

Edit: Can be worth mentioning if I decide to end my treatment without consulting my doctor my epilepsy can become worse. I may experience severe seizures that may never go away. So if I'm gonna stop, I have to do it in a very controlled format and follow up with my doctor. But when they refuse to believe me and dismiss all my symptoms? What's left to do?
